success_criteria_met.criterion: Vendors menu appears in sidebar with 3 subitems
Vendor list displays in responsive grid
Clicking vendor card navigates to detail page
Detail page shows 3-column layout (main content + KPI sidebar)
Vendor info form stays visible at top
Tab switching works with local state
All components use mock data from mockData.js
Condensed spacing throughout (p-4, text-sm, w-4 h-4 icons)
No API calls or useQuery hooks

design_patterns_implemented.description: Only main content area re-renders, dashboard header/sidebar stay constant
design_patterns_implemented.implementation: VendorsContent.jsx acts as router, switches between list/detail/metrics views

design_patterns_implemented.description: Top section stays fixed while tab content scrolls independently
design_patterns_implemented.implementation: VendorDetail.jsx uses flex-shrink-0 for vendor info and tabs, overflow-y-auto for tab content

design_patterns_implemented.description: Tighter spacing than other dashboard sections
design_patterns_implemented.implementation: p-4 instead of p-6, text-sm instead of text-base, w-4 h-4 icons instead of w-5 h-5

design_patterns_implemented.description: No useQuery/useMutation calls, no API calls
design_patterns_implemented.implementation: All data fetched from mockData.js using getter functions

design_patterns_implemented.description: Horizontal tabs with green underline for active tab
design_patterns_implemented.implementation: VendorTabs.jsx lines match CreateQuickPOs.jsx pattern (border-b, green underline, py-3)
VendorKPICard.jsx follows existing MetricCard patterns with condensed spacing

accessibility_features.implementation: All buttons have aria-label attributes (e.g., 'Edit address', 'Delete contact')
All interactive elements are <button> tags with keyboard support
Proper heading hierarchy (h2, h3, h4), list structures, table markup
All inputs and buttons have focus:outline and focus:ring styles
Meaningful labels, aria-current for active tabs, descriptive text
All text meets WCAG AA contrast ratios (4.5:1 for normal text)

mobile_responsiveness.implementation: Single column layouts, grid-cols-1, stacked forms, full-width buttons
Two-column grids (grid-cols-2), condensed sidebar, responsive tables
Multi-column layouts (grid-cols-3), full sidebar visible, 3-column detail layout
